corrections.issue: Inconsistent A/B costs, Q increments and shared preliminary work across table columns
corrections.resolution: Fixed A total=30 including10 shared hours, A increment=5. B total=20+x including10 shared hours, B increment=7. Only x varies:0,8,20. Costs A=6; B≈2.86,4,5.71. No measured counts are mixed with illustrative expectations.

corrections.issue: Cost equality used without capacity; single-path choice falsely justified as budget exclusivity
corrections.resolution: x=22 solves30/5=(20+x)/7 but needs42>40 hours. Feasible B domain0≤x≤20; x>20 excludesB while feasible A remains. Shared A+B costs10+20+10=40, so one intervention is an explicit trial-design assumption. Shared A+B total40 applies only at x=0; otherwise40+x needs its own capacity check.

corrections.issue: e/Ev thresholds disagreed between columns, body and actions
corrections.resolution: All sensitivity columns fix e=2/25,Ev=8,g=0.6. B requires e<3/25,Ev≥8 items per25 questions,g≥0.5, sufficient40-hour capacity and positive increment. All paths check capacity before cost. Integer error counts cannot equal2.5.

corrections.issue: S2 table ranges omitted large/censored values; model names assigned from flattened group headings
corrections.resolution: Six model columns. Finite evidence odds ratios2.09–46.3 plus one>10000; price6.26–36.1 plus two>10000; depth3.98–1480 plus one>10000. No per-model attribution, no probability interpretation, no exact estimate for>10000.

corrections.issue: S2 organization and consistency rows wrongly characterized as near1 or reversed
corrections.resolution: Only structured/dense includes values below1; organization and consistency also have clearly above1 values. Convergence warnings, model variation and limited B2C two-source setting remain explicit.
Explicit2020 date and England/Wales jurisdiction; not extrapolated to China or AI citations.

corrections.issue: Hypotheses described as established causal chains; post-intervention effects promised from baseline alone
corrections.resolution: Hypotheses need comparable intervention observations in addition to a2-week baseline. Schedule is baseline2weeks, intervention observation2weeks, ledger reviewweek5.40-hour total covers baseline and intervention. S2 did not test publication volume; no claim about its effect is drawn.

corrections.issue: Q counted as a rate; incomplete cost ledger and undefined final minimum thresholds
corrections.resolution: Q is a question count; rate isQ/25. Shared work counted once; unused capacity is not incurred effort. No new6-hour/minimum-question threshold; chooseC if no feasible positive-increment path.

corrections.issue: Untranslated Chinese and wrong conditions/units in English/Arabic output
corrections.resolution: Replaced all Chinese body fallbacks, corrected Ev evidence-item units and reversed applicability condition, and aligned every table cell, inequality and capacity decision with corrected Chinese. Manual edits are not attributed to HyMT.
